title: Orsen and the Playlist
author: Wendell Thackeray
blurb: Petra Okafor, the new kid at a school built over something old, counts days until graduation like a sentence being served. Then a group chat starts predicting things that haven't happened yet — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must tell the truth even if it costs the friendship, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
